scope: Focused Windows/Radeon verification of image-main e46e72e9 integrated with NVFP4. Not Linux, split, timing, released-depth or hosted qualification.

build.purpose: Fresh image-main/NVFP4 conflict integration build, not a full landing gate.

wide_hf.scope: Integrated Windows wide shared-float HF check against the frozen independent reference. Candidate only, not matched timing or a depth check.

native_f16_hf.scope: Single Radeon with existing wide split-fixture weights, no tensor split. Six 129-token logit and six window-NLL checks, ordinary/scaled dense tied/untied and MoE. Requires native f16 path in every completed measurement. No depth or speed claim.

integration: Preserved main paced vision encoder and shared non-NVFP4 tile prefetch, NVFP4 scale operands and paired tile path. Adapted two new BF16 benchmark calls to WeightView. Generator choices and encoder docs retain both features.
harness_note: Initial HF wrapper stopped before inference because its CTest-log reader omitted PowerShell UTF-16 encoding. Corrected the reader without changing any product, fixture or limit.
